name: When should I hire a general contractor for rental property repairs instead of a handyman?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor for rental property repairs instead of a handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a general contractor for larger projects that involve multiple trades, require permits, or complex coordination, such as a major renovation, water damage restoration, or a complete kitchen or bathroom remodel. Handymen are suitable for smaller, isolated tasks like fixing a leaky faucet, painting a single room, or minor carpentry. A general contractor provides oversight, manages subcontractors, and ensures compliance with building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for large, complex projects involving multiple trades or permits; a handyman is suitable for small, isolated tasks.
